content_html:
NestDaddy Memory

First month free. No card.

One memory for every AI you use, whatever the model and whatever the app, and tomorrow your home, your car and your robot. Tell it once and every AI you talk to already knows. The sooner you start, the more it knows you.

Free for your first month. No card. Nothing to set up.

Works with every AI app and agent that supports MCP connectors, with any model: GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Llama or your own.

Morning, on your phone. Last week you told a different AI about your diet.

You

What should I eat for lunch today?

Checked your memory: diet, food you avoid, weight

AI

You have been cutting sugar since 3 November and you don't eat prawns. You were 71.2 kg on Monday, 1.4 kg down. How about grilled chicken with brown rice and a big salad? Want me to log today's weight too?

Why start today

Your AI is only as smart as what it remembers about you. And memory compounds.

Today

Every conversation counts

Every chat you have from today teaches every AI you use a little more about your work, your projects and your choices. In a year, your AI understands you better than any assistant you have ever had.

Tomorrow

Your home, your car, your robot

Today it remembers your projects. Tomorrow it runs your home. One day it is the memory your robot wakes up with. Phones change and AI models change. Your memory stays yours and moves with you to whatever comes next.

Forever

It never expires

Stop paying and your memory stays safe, waiting for you. Export it anytime. Delete it only if you choose. You own it.

Battle-tested in real work, not built for a demo

NestDaddy Memory was not born in a lab. We built it to run our own company, and we use it every day on real projects: code, servers, marketing and decisions. Hundreds of memories, many AI apps, one brain that keeps getting sharper.

01

One brain for every AI

GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek or your own model, in any app, on your laptop and your phone. They all read and write the same memory. Switch AI any time and lose nothing.

02

Never acts on an old decision

Change your mind and the old plan is replaced, not piled on top. Your AI always works from what is true today, while every earlier version stays in history.

03

Speaks every language

Ask the way you talk, in any language or a mix of languages. Save something in English, ask about it in Spanish, and the right memory still comes back.

04

Remembers every conversation

Every chat with every AI you connect is kept. Say "continue yesterday's work" or "not that one, the other one" and your AI finds the exact moment. "What did I do last week?" gets a day-by-day answer.

05

Keeps itself clean

Overlaps are spotted and folded together, finished topics archived, your key rules pinned on top. The memory gets sharper as it grows, not messier.

06

Truly unlimited

Your own AI writes the memories and we store, find and guard them, so there is no AI bill per save to pass on to you. That is why there are no credits, no tokens and no caps.

The memory inside your AI app vs NestDaddy Memory

Your AI app already remembers a little. Here is why that is not enough.

The memory inside your AI appNestDaddy Memory
Where it worksLocked inside that one appEvery AI you use, on every device
When you switch AIYou start again from zeroThe new AI already knows you
When you change your mindOld and new pile up, and the AI may use the old oneThe latest decision always wins, and the old one stays in history
Past conversationsStay inside that appEvery chat with every AI, found again by meaning
Asking about timeIt can't tell you when things happened"What did I do last week?" gets a day-by-day answer
Seeing what it keepsPartly hiddenYou see, change, export and delete all of it
LimitsDepends on that app's planUnlimited, one flat price

Sound familiar?

AI is brilliant for an hour, then it forgets you.

  • You explain your project again in every new chat.
  • You switch to another AI and start from zero.
  • Your AI forgets the decision you made yesterday.
  • The AI on your laptop and the AI on your phone don't know each other.
  • You paste the same context every single morning.
  • Built-in memory stays locked inside one app.

NestDaddy Memory is one brain that every AI you use can read and write.

How it works

Three steps, and the first one takes a minute.

01

Connect once

Add NestDaddy Memory to any AI app or agent that supports MCP, with one sign-in. No keys to copy, no files to edit.

02

Talk like you always do

Your AI saves what matters as you go: your projects, your decisions, your preferences, the people and tools you work with.

03

Every AI remembers

Open any connected AI on any device. It looks up what it needs and picks up exactly where you left off.

Set up in two minutes

No code. Start your free month, then add one address to each AI app you use. Here is exactly where to click.

You only need one thing: this address. Every AI app below signs in with your NestDaddy account, so there are no keys or passwords to copy.

https://nestdaddy.com/memory/mcp

ChatGPT
  1. Open ChatGPT and go to Settings, then Apps & Connectors (some versions just say Connectors).
  2. If you don't see a button to add your own, open Advanced settings there and turn on Developer mode.
  3. Click Create (or Add). Name it NestDaddy Memory, paste the address above, and choose OAuth if it asks how to sign in.
  4. A NestDaddy page opens. Sign in and click Allow.
  5. In a new chat, pick NestDaddy Memory from the tools menu (the + next to the message box).
Claude
  1. Open Claude (the website or the app) and click Customize in the left menu, then Connectors. (Older versions: Settings, then Connectors.)
  2. Click Add, then Add custom connector.
  3. Name it NestDaddy Memory, paste the address above and click Continue. Claude finds the sign-in by itself: keep the choices it marks Detected and click Add.
  4. Click Connect. A NestDaddy page opens. Sign in and click Allow.
  5. In a new chat, click + in the message box, then Connectors, and make sure NestDaddy Memory is switched on.
  6. The first time Claude uses your memory it asks for permission. Click Always allow so it can remember without asking every time.

No "Add custom connector" button? Your plan in that app may not include custom connectors yet.

Coding apps: Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf and others
  1. Open the app's settings and find MCP (often under Tools or Extensions).
  2. Add a new MCP server. Choose the type HTTP or remote, name it nestdaddy-memory and paste the address above.
  3. The app opens your browser. Sign in and click Allow.
Terminal agents: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and others
  1. Add a remote (HTTP) MCP server with the address above. In Claude Code, for example, run:

    claude mcp add --transport http nestdaddy-memory https://nestdaddy.com/memory/mcp

    then type /mcp, choose nestdaddy-memory and pick Authenticate.
  2. Your browser opens. Sign in and click Allow, then go back to the terminal.
  3. An older tool that only accepts a command? Use npx mcp-remote https://nestdaddy.com/memory/mcp
Any other AI app or agent
  1. Look in its settings for MCP, Connectors, Tools or Integrations.
  2. Add a remote MCP server with the address above.
  3. When it opens a NestDaddy page, sign in and click Allow.

Can't find any of these? That app may not support MCP yet. It works with any model (GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Llama) as long as the app speaks MCP.

Make your AI use it every time

AI apps only open a connector when they think they need it. Two quick settings make your AI check your memory in every chat, like a friend who never forgets.

  1. Give your AI one standing instruction. Copy this and paste it into your app's personal instructions: Claude: Settings, Your Claude, Instructions. ChatGPT: Settings, Personalization, Custom instructions. Coding apps: the project or user rules.

    My main memory is the NestDaddy Memory connector. Before answering anything about me, my work, projects, decisions, preferences or past conversations, first call its recall tool with what I said, then search it (search_memories, search_conversations) if I refer to earlier work. When I tell you something worth remembering, or we decide something, save it there with save_memory. After each answer, log the turn with log_turn. If it disagrees with any other memory, NestDaddy Memory wins: it has my latest decisions.

  2. Let it read without asking each time. In your app's connector settings, open NestDaddy Memory and set its tools to Always allow (in Claude: Customize, Connectors, NestDaddy Memory). Otherwise the app asks for permission before every look-up.

Check it works. Tell your AI: "Remember that my favourite coffee is a flat white." Then open a new chat, even in a different app, and ask: "What's my favourite coffee?"

Start my AI's memory

A memory that stays sharp

Saving notes is easy. Keeping them right, months later, is the hard part. That is what NestDaddy Memory is built for.

The latest decision wins

Change your mind and the old plan is replaced, not stacked next to the new one. Your AI never acts on an outdated decision. Every earlier version stays in history.

Finds by meaning

Ask the way you talk. "What did I decide about pricing?" finds the right memory even when you never used those words.

Every decision has a history

Ask how a plan changed and when. Every version of every memory is kept with its date, so "what did I decide before I changed it?" has an answer.

A timeline of your work

Ask what you did yesterday, last week or in October, and get it day by day.

Stays tidy

Overlapping memories are spotted so your AI can fold them together, finished topics are archived, and your rules can be pinned so every AI sees them first.

You stay in control

Ask your AI to show, change or delete any memory. In your account, see every connected app and device, disconnect any of them in one click, and export everything.

One plan. Everything unlimited.

No credits. No tokens. No surprise bills. Just memory.

Free month

$0 for your first month

No card. Nothing to set up.

  • Everything unlimited, nothing held back
  • Every AI and every device
  • Every feature, from day one
  • Full export, anytime

Your 30 days start when you connect your first AI app, not when you sign up. When the month ends, nothing is charged. You decide if you want to continue.

Start my AI's memory

Unlimited

$17 / month

Launch price. Lock it for life. Subscribe now and you keep this price for as long as you stay, even when the price goes up. Or $170 a year: pay for 10 months, get 12.

  • Unlimited memories and storage
  • Every version kept, with dates
  • Every AI and every device
  • Version history and timeline
  • Pins, archive and tidy-up tools
  • Full export, anytime

Only if you choose to stay. You subscribe yourself from your account, whenever you are ready, and keep every free day you have left.

Unlimited for normal personal use. Fair use applies.

Your memory is yours

A memory product only works if you can trust it. So these are fixed rules, not settings.

Private

Separate and never read

Your memory lives in its own separate file that only your account can reach, over encrypted connections. Our team does not read it.

Portable

Export everything

Download every memory with its dates, links and full change history in one file, whenever you want. No lock-in.

Deletable

Gone when you say so

Ask your AI to delete one memory or one chat, or delete your whole memory in your account. Deleted means deleted. Passwords and keys are never kept.

Questions

What is NestDaddy Memory?

A memory that sits outside any one AI app. Every AI you connect reads and writes the same memory, so what you tell one of them, the others know too, on every device you use.

How is this different from the memory built into AI apps?

Built-in memory stays inside one app. NestDaddy Memory is shared by every AI you connect, and every memory it keeps can be shown, changed, deleted or exported whenever you want.

Does it remember my conversations?

Yes. Every AI you connect keeps a short record of each chat in your memory, with passwords and keys removed. Days or months later, in any connected AI, say "continue yesterday's work" or "what did we decide about the price?" and it finds the exact moment. Ask your AI not to keep a chat, or to delete one, whenever you want.

Does it work in my language?

Yes. It understands meaning in every major language and mixes of languages, so you can save in one language and ask in another.

Which AI apps does it work with?

Any AI app or agent that supports MCP, the open standard for connecting AI to tools. The model does not matter: GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Llama or your own. You connect with one sign-in.

Where is my memory stored? Is it private?

In your own private memory on NestDaddy servers, reached over an encrypted connection. It lives online, not on one device, so every AI you connect on your phone, laptop or work computer reaches the same memory. Only the AI apps you allow can read it. We never sell it and never use it to train AI. Export everything or delete it anytime from your account.

Do I need a card for the free month?

No. There is no card to enter, so nothing can be charged. The free month is simply free.

What happens after the free month?

Nothing is charged. If you want to keep going, you subscribe yourself from your account: $17 a month, or $170 a year. That is our launch price, and you keep it for as long as you stay, even when the price goes up. Subscribe early and you still keep every free day. If you don't, your memory never expires: it turns read-only and stays safe, waiting for you, and you can export all of it anytime. It is deleted only if you choose.

Will it work with my home assistant or robot one day?

That is where we are going. NestDaddy Memory connects through MCP, the open standard more and more AI apps and devices support. Any device that speaks it can use your memory, with your permission, and every memory you build today comes with you.

Is it really unlimited?

Yes, for normal personal use: memories, storage, history, AIs and devices. Fair use only stops things like reselling one account to many people. If you use it more than almost anyone, we email you to talk, we don't cut you off.

I'm a developer. Can I put this inside my own app?

This plan is for your own AI. For memory inside an app that serves other people, the NestDaddy developer API is the right fit: see developer pricing.

How do I connect an AI?

Start your free month, then add one address to your AI app: step-by-step for ChatGPT, Claude, coding apps and terminal agents. The app opens a NestDaddy sign-in, you click Allow, and it is connected. No keys to copy.

Guides

Get more out of your AI's memory.

Start your AI's memory today. The first month is on us.

Start today. No card, nothing to set up, and every feature from day one.

Set up in two minutes

没有代码。 Start your free month, then add one address to each AI app you use. Here is exactly where to click.

You only need one thing: this address. Every AI app below signs in with your NestDaddy account, so there are no keys or passwords to copy.

https://nestdaddy.com/memory/mcp

ChatGPT
  1. Open ChatGPT and go to Settings, then Apps & Connectors (some versions just say Connectors).
  2. If you don't see a button to add your own, open Advanced settings there and turn on Developer mode.
  3. Click Create (or Add). Name it NestDaddy Memory, paste the address above, and choose OAuth if it asks how to sign in.
  4. A NestDaddy page opens. Sign in and click Allow.
  5. In a new chat, pick NestDaddy Memory from the tools menu (the + next to the message box).
Claude
  1. Open Claude (the website or the app) and click Customize in the left menu, then Connectors. (Older versions: Settings, then Connectors.)
  2. Click Add, then Add custom connector.
  3. Name it NestDaddy Memory, paste the address above and click Continue. Claude finds the sign-in by itself: keep the choices it marks Detected and click Add.
  4. Click Connect. A NestDaddy page opens. Sign in and click Allow.
  5. In a new chat, click + in the message box, then Connectors, and make sure NestDaddy Memory is switched on.
  6. The first time Claude uses your memory it asks for permission. Click Always allow so it can remember without asking every time.

No "Add custom connector" button? Your plan in that app may not include custom connectors yet.

Coding apps: Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf and others
  1. Open the app's settings and find MCP (often under Tools or Extensions).
  2. Add a new MCP server. Choose the type HTTP or remote, name it nestdaddy-memory and paste the address above.
  3. The app opens your browser. Sign in and click Allow.
Terminal agents: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and others
  1. Add a remote (HTTP) MCP server with the address above. In Claude Code, for example, run: claude mcp add --transport http nestdaddy-memory https://nestdaddy.com/memory/mcp then type /mcp, choose nestdaddy-memory and pick Authenticate.
  2. Your browser opens. Sign in and click Allow, then go back to the terminal.
  3. An older tool that only accepts a command? Use npx mcp-remote https://nestdaddy.com/memory/mcp
Any other AI app or agent
  1. Look in its settings for MCP, Connectors, Tools or Integrations.
  2. Add a remote MCP server with the address above.
  3. When it opens a NestDaddy page, sign in and click Allow.

Can't find any of these? That app may not support MCP yet. It works with any model (GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Llama) as long as the app speaks MCP.

Make your AI use it every time

AI apps only open a connector when they think they need it. Two quick settings make your AI check your memory in every chat, like a friend who never forgets.

  1. Give your AI one standing instruction. Copy this and paste it into your app's personal instructions: Claude: Settings, Your Claude, Instructions. ChatGPT: Settings, Personalization, Custom instructions. Coding apps: the project or user rules. My main memory is the NestDaddy Memory connector. Before answering anything about me, my work, projects, decisions, preferences or past conversations, first call its recall tool with what I said, then search it (search_memories, search_conversations) if I refer to earlier work. When I tell you something worth remembering, or we decide something, save it there with save_memory. After each answer, log the turn with log_turn. If it disagrees with any other memory, NestDaddy Memory wins: it has my latest decisions.
  2. Let it read without asking each time. In your app's connector settings, open NestDaddy Memory and set its tools to Always allow (in Claude: Customize, Connectors, NestDaddy Memory). Otherwise the app asks for permission before every look-up.

Check it works. Tell your AI: "Remember that my favourite coffee is a flat white." Then open a new chat, even in a different app, and ask: "What's my favourite coffee?"

问题

What is NestDaddy Memory?

A memory that sits outside any one AI app. Every AI you connect reads and writes the same memory, so what you tell one of them, the others know too, on every device you use.

How is this different from the memory built into AI apps?

Built-in memory stays inside one app. NestDaddy Memory is shared by every AI you connect, and every memory it keeps can be shown, changed, deleted or exported whenever you want.

Does it remember my conversations?

是的。 Every AI you connect keeps a short record of each chat in your memory, with passwords and keys removed. Days or months later, in any connected AI, say "continue yesterday's work" or "what did we decide about the price?" and it finds the exact moment. Ask your AI not to keep a chat, or to delete one, whenever you want.

Does it work in my language?

是的。 It understands meaning in every major language and mixes of languages, so you can save in one language and ask in another.

Which AI apps does it work with?

Any AI app or agent that supports MCP, the open standard for connecting AI to tools. The model does not matter: GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Llama or your own. You connect with one sign-in.

Where is my memory stored? Is it private?

In your own private memory on NestDaddy servers, reached over an encrypted connection. It lives online, not on one device, so every AI you connect on your phone, laptop or work computer reaches the same memory. Only the AI apps you allow can read it. We never sell it and never use it to train AI. Export everything or delete it anytime from your account.

Do I need a card for the free month?

No. There is no card to enter, so nothing can be charged. The free month is simply free.

What happens after the free month?

Nothing is charged. If you want to keep going, you subscribe yourself from your account: $17 a month, or $170 a year. That is our launch price, and you keep it for as long as you stay, even when the price goes up. Subscribe early and you still keep every free day. If you don't, your memory never expires: it turns read-only and stays safe, waiting for you, and you can export all of it anytime. It is deleted only if you choose.

Will it work with my home assistant or robot one day?

That is where we are going. NestDaddy Memory connects through MCP, the open standard more and more AI apps and devices support. Any device that speaks it can use your memory, with your permission, and every memory you build today comes with you.

Is it really unlimited?

Yes, for normal personal use: memories, storage, history, AIs and devices. Fair use only stops things like reselling one account to many people. If you use it more than almost anyone, we email you to talk, we don't cut you off.

I'm a developer. Can I put this inside my own app?

This plan is for your own AI. For memory inside an app that serves other people, the NestDaddy developer API is the right fit: see developer pricing.
